title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：playground　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 playground 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the headmaster ① openned the playground that no student in the school would have counted, and he said the openning was the whole of the year. The ② playground, meaning the field itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a playground, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ playground in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ playground at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A playground, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the headmaster said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the playground was the whole of the matter, meaning the freedom and not the field. The ⑥ playground, meaning the freedom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; playground, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a field and a freedom. He said the freedom is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ playground had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ playground of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of counting; playground, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ playground I remember is the field counted in the record, which closed in 1966 and is still counted as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ playground, my mother said in 1968, is the only field that improves by being counted; every playground, she said, is a freedom that has agreed to look like a field. She said the freedom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 操场；游乐场（指学堂里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 操场；游乐场（指那个操场本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：open the playground 开放这一个操场
D. n. 操场；游乐场（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 操场之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的操场之事）
F. n. 操场；游乐场（指学籍册里写到、被清点的那一个）
G. n. 操场、自在（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 自在（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: openned the playground that no student in the school would have counted
The playground, meaning the field itself and not the bell
the playground at the far gate
the playground was the whole of the matter
the playground had become a line in a record
The playground of the whole thing
A playground, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: open the playground 意为“开放这一个操场”，1959 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯清点的一个操场做了一遍。
playground 意为“操场；游乐场”，指那个操场本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被清点。
playground 意为“操场；游乐场”，指学堂里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
playground 意为“操场；游乐场”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
playground 意为“操场、自在”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个自在就是那件事的全部。
playground 意为“自在”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个操场，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
playground 意为“操场；游乐场”，指学籍册里写到、被清点的那一个，到 1964 年这一个成了学籍册里的一行。
playground 意为“操场之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的操场之事是一处学堂和三个学年的清点。
playground 意为“操场；游乐场”，我记得的是学籍册里清点过的那一个，1966 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一个。
playground 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，操场是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的操场。
